/bin/zsh -lc "git checkout -- specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
cat >> specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md <<'EOF'

## Conversation list

- A list request accepts an optional integer limit from 1 to 200 and an optional cursor containing a parseable "'`updatedAt` string and a `sessionId`, and rejects invalid fields ([validated by: validates a list request and its composite cursor](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L14)).
- With history enabled, a list request returns only the authenticated connection user'"'s conversation summaries, without content, using the requested page even if the frame names another user ([validated by: returns only the authenticated user’s summaries and pages them over the socket](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L40)).
- With history disabled, a list request receives an "'`UNSUPPORTED` error rather than a list ([validated by: refuses a list when history is disabled](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L71)).
EOF
python3 - <<'"'PY'
p='src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts'

open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md
npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts"
